description: PM-posture skill the PM runs, in a pm session or as the pm agent, after a change unit lands or halts. It reads what the unit left (its flow findings, its code-integrity report, its security report, the developer's closing commit and its `Deferred:` lines, any deferred_decisions.md, the corrections its plan owed to records outside its reach, and the work its spec handed on) and what moved in the product's upstream documents since the unit's seed was cut, then acts on the project's route with six moves (modify a seed, modify a station, park a station, un-pick the active seed to free the slot, raise a companion item on an upstream document, drop a halted unit through tobiishi-drop) and always leaves two files with the seed, a report and a recommendations file to the Principal PM. The report opens with the next moves the run leaves owed — each with its seat and the command that starts it — and the completion message carries them. Requires PM posture and halts outside a pm session or the pm subagent. It never drops or closes a seed and never writes a new one. Not stations-from-seed, which routes one seed before it is walked, from the seed alone.
